title: Traditional Greek Loukoumades with Honey Syrup
description: A classic Greek dessert consisting of crispy fried dough balls drizzled with a sweet honey syrup. Loukoumades are often served with a sprinkle of cinnamon and a drizzle of honey.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
Combine the flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Gradually add the sugar and yogurt to the dry ingredients, mixing until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes elastic.
Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into small pieces, about the size of a small egg.
Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Fry the dough balls in batches for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the loukoumades from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Repeat the frying process with the remaining dough balls.
To make the honey syrup, combine the honey and 1 cup of water in a saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Drizzle the honey syrup over the loukoumades and sprinkle with ground cinnamon.
